edits.original: Field crews still collect vouchers, make no mistake.
edits.reason: "Make no mistake" is a finality interjection tacked onto a claim that already carries its own emphatic work; it adds no evidence.

edits.original: so the change significantly streamlines cell-wall composition analysis.
edits.replacement: so the change cuts assay time from 40 minutes to 6 minutes.
edits.reason: "Significantly" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; the specific numbers (40 minutes to 6 minutes) already stated provide the evidence.

edits.original: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle, full stop.
edits.replacement: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle.
edits.reason: "Full stop" is a finality interjection repeating the exclusivity already carried by "only"; it adds no evidence.

edits.original: dramatically increased food production, averting famines in many regions.
edits.replacement: increased food production, averting famines in many regions.
edits.reason: "Dramatically" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; the outcome (averting famines) already conveys the magnitude.

edits.original: so supplemental irrigation dramatically reduces yield loss in dry years.

edits.reason: "Dramatically" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; the specific numbers (41 percent to 8 percent) already stated provide the evidence.
